name: Daily question
summary: Posts a conversation starter every day at a time you choose, and adds !question.
description: Thirty friendly questions. One is posted each day at the time and in the channel you set (in every community the bot serves that has that channel), and anyone can ask for another with !question. Set the channel, time and time zone under Settings → Daily question.
author: lucky-edgelord

settings.label: Channel
settings.help: Where the daily question is posted
